findings.title: Broken Navigation Link to Missing Route (/broken-route)
findings.description: The navigation header or page anchor points to /broken-route which does not exist in the routing manifest, producing a 404 user drop-off.
findings.observedEvidence: Observed HTTP 404 Not Found response when browser navigated to http://localhost:4173/broken-route.
findings.aiHypothesis: The developer likely renamed or deleted the broken route or made a typo in the href attribute (e.g., href="/broken-route" instead of a valid route like "/about").
findings.suggestedFix: Update the anchor href in navigation or create the missing page file at src/app/broken-route/page.tsx.
findings.patchPreview:
--- a/src/components/Navigation.tsx
+++ b/src/components/Navigation.tsx
@@ -12,3 +12,3 @@
-<Link href="/broken-route" className="nav-link">Broken Link</Link>
+<Link href="/about" className="nav-link">About Us</Link>
findings.sideEffects: None; routes correctly to existing About page.
findings.verificationStep: Re-run PROOFix Navigation Flow test to verify 200 OK response.

findings.title: Internal Server Error (500) on API Route /api/data
findings.description: The endpoint /api/data crashed during request execution due to an unhandled database connection failure.
findings.observedEvidence: Server returned HTTP 500 with network failure reason "ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432".
findings.aiHypothesis: The database connection pool fails to connect because no PostgreSQL instance is running on localhost:5432, or the DATABASE_URL environment variable is unset/invalid.
findings.suggestedFix: Add connection error handling with fallback or mock data in development mode when DATABASE_URL is unavailable.
findings.sideEffects: Returns empty fallback payload when database is unreachable instead of crashing with HTTP 500.
findings.verificationStep: Re-run PROOFix API Health Check to ensure graceful recovery.
